column1: # tools/perch-surfaces.tsv -- the fourteen surfaces of APPENDIX-NORMATIVE.md §1 (ADR 0011 clause 1).
# Read by tools/check-perch-surface-count.sh, which asserts EXACTLY fourteen
# rows, that every routed row s path is declared in
# workspace/desktop/src/app/routes.ts, and that every row s component file
# exists. Fourteen is a decision: a console with a fifteenth surface has one
# an operator was never told about, and the cost of a surface is not the code
# but the place a person has to remember to look.
# A route of `-` means the surface is reached from inside another one.
